meta.revisionPolicy: Section 42 figures are provisional, then final; sectoral credit is provisional and revised the next month; NPAs and capital ratios are final on release. Seams disclosed, never joined: the 2019 sectoral classification, the July 2023 HDFC merger, the December 2025 reporting calendar.
meta.base: RBI asset classification, as on 31 March
meta.coverage: Every bank loan by its health: standard, sub-standard, doubtful and loss advances, summed over all scheduled commercial banks, every March since 2004
meta.note: RBI DBIE report 336 (Bank-wise and bank group-wise classification of loan assets), summed over every bank in the report, ₹ lakh crore. The report's unit column is unreliable; values are rupees.
